title: Ohio Woman Faces Off with Florida Cops at Walmart
description:
An Ohio woman was arrested at a Florida Walmart after allegedly shoplifting various grocery items. Deputies arrested Keyairah Harper, 27, after she was accused of going through a self-checkout and only scanning a few of her items, according to the Lake County Sheriff’s Officer. An arrest report shows Harper tried to exit the store with $92 worth of unscanned items, but it wasn’t long until law enforcement intervened. Harper was booked for Petit Theft. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
